summary: Brinova Fastigheter AB (publ) engages in the real estate business in Sweden. It owns, develops, and manages rental housing and community services properties, including special housing, healthcare, leisure, education, and public administration, as well as complementary commercial premises. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Helsingborg, Sweden. Brinova Fastigheter AB (publ) operates as a subsidiary of K-Fast Holding AB (publ).
